text.textPath: The dawn city bus runs with its windows decked in some dazzling finery. The
harsher the dead of winter, the more vividly the frost flowers bloom. Those who rode this bus yesterday maidens and
bachelors, children and grown-ups, hairdressers, salesmen, housemaids, the jobless their breath and their sighs met in secret overnight and brought forth this flashing, breathtaking

beauty. As if I had wandered into some exhibition, I move from seat to seat to look, and once again I am drunk on a single petal, on its delicate and cold beauty. Whose desolate sigh was this? What warm heart breathed out this breath of passion? For no reason, carefully,
